changed_factors: Introduce clock-free O(B*K*D) Theory 1A Gersho Total-Variance & Kantorovich-Laguerre Pullback Prior Dynamics (prior_regularizer='t1_pullback', t1_pullback_weight=1.5, t1_iso_weight=0.60, t1_laguerre_lr=0.015, t1_prior_row_lr=0.06, t1_max_prototypes=256) on top of the EMPF critic/DualNorm backbone under one global schedule-free recipe: (1) streaming Zador-Gersho quantizer (C_k, w_k, sigma_{cell,k}^2) with slow empirical mass EMA w_k, Robbins-Monro hit-cooled centroids, uncovered-mode teleportation, and mass-conserving w_k^{d/(d+2)} sigma_{cell,k}^2 distortion splitting; (2) Part A smooth generator chart training G_theta (with prior.z detached) via mass-weighted Sinkhorn barycentric projection + local Gersho pullback kernel isometry (including exact deterministic 2D orthogonal companion probe and inverse-density rare-mode stiffness) + residual-driven DualNorm step settling; and (3) Part B Kantorovich-Laguerre mass-balanced island condensation on sampled prior rows (with G_theta frozen) via persistent dual potentials psi_k, isometric latent cloud envelope sigma_mu*, and bias-corrected coherent drift-SNR row updates.
mechanism_rationale: Existing global recipes (empf-v8, rhbi-v12, bcap, ka2) tether prior std(mu) ~= 1 and couple G and prior.z through one noisy single-batch gradient: on 100-mode lattices (grid100, rotated100, staggered100) any smooth G: [-2,2]^2 -> [-4.5,4.5]^2 must have median ||J_G|| >= 2.25 (inflating sigma_z=0.025 kernels to 1.9*sigma_data, precision ~0.33 in empf-v8) while tight Hellinger screening drops distant modes (13/100 on grid100, 2/4 on img_bars4 in rhbi-v12) and single-batch Sinkhorn spills ~25% of particles across empty valleys due to multinomial count variance. Enforcing Gersho's Law of Total Variance via a strict Division of Labor — Part A training a low-energy global chart G_theta with local within-cell pullback kernel width sigma_{cell,k} while Part B condenses sampled prior rows into exact mass-balanced Laguerre islands inside an expanded isometric envelope sigma_mu* — eliminates cross-valley bridges, Jacobian cliffs, and rare/unequal-width mode distortion simultaneously in O(B*K*D) time with zero step clocks and zero extra RNG draws.
